products.title: Wilson Blade V4 2026 - Wilson
products.description:
WILSON BLADE V4 2026 - The new Blade arrives renewed, with a slight design change and with improved technologies to achieve a more balanced and durable racket. Without a doubt, one of the Wilson rackets with the best quality-price ratio. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The WILSON BLADE V4 2026 arrives completely renewed to continue being one of the brand's most balanced padel rackets. Its teardrop format helps us achieve that balance so desired by players.

It is a racket that transmits a lot of confidence both from the back of the court and in the net game.

PLAYER TYPE

Designed for players looking for an excellent compromise between control, power and comfort, it offers a very versatile behavior that adapts to any match situation.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The materials in the WILSON BLADE V4 2026 are quality. We find a combination of carbon fiber and fiberglass. With this duo, a balanced, flexible feel and good durability are achieved.

Its rubber is firm Foam, a hard and stable rubber that increases the power in our blows, but also leaving us with the characteristic softness of foam rubber.

Its technologies are: a rough surface Spin Effect Texture, which facilitates the generation of effects. Its C2 Tubular Construction structure, made entirely of carbon. In addition, the Anti-Fragile Edge protector reinforces the frame against bumps and scratches, while the Duo Grid Hole system optimizes the performance of the hitting surface.

products.title: Head Extreme Pro 2026 - Head
products.description:
HEAD EXTREME PRO 2026 - We present the most powerful racket in the Extreme collection, a true attacking machine that stands out for its explosive punch and firmness in offensive hits. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The HEAD EXTREME PRO 2026 arrives with a diamond format and high balance, a configuration that favors power and allows you to make the most of the inertia of the racket. It concentrates greater inertia in the upper part, favoring shots and blows above the head.

PLAYER TYPE

If you are one of those who look for any opportunity to get up to the net and finish the point, this Extreme Pro has a lot to offer you. It is a padel racket with a clearly offensive character, one of those that brings out its best version when we play with determination and hit with good technique.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The HEAD EXTREME PRO 2026 stands out for its UD Carbon HS carbon construction that provides rigidity, while the Power Foam core provides a fast and energetic response. In addition, it incorporates the new Auxetic 2.0 technology to improve the sensations and connection with the ball in each impact.

It also incorporates Extreme Spin technology, a 3D roughness that facilitates spin, and Optimized Sweet Spot, which optimizes the distribution of the holes to improve the useful hitting area.

On the other hand, we continue with the Tailored Frame construction to help achieve a more consistent response, while the Soft Cap+ system improves grip comfort, reducing vibrations.

CARACTERÍSTICAS DE LA PALA

Por dentro incorpora SC Black EVA de densidad 15, una goma que acompaña muy bien al carbono 12K. El resultado es un tacto equilibrado, con buena salida de bola cuando jugamos a menor velocidad y una respuesta más contundente cuando apretamos el golpe..

El acabado Hybrid Spin ayuda a trabajar los efectos en víboras, bandejas y golpes cortados.

También incorpora un mango más largo, un detalle especialmente interesante para jugadores que utilizan el revés a dos manos.

products.englishDescription:

PLAYER TYPE

We recommend this model for experienced high-level players who want a professional racket to perform at their best.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

On the planes we find 12K Power Carbon, which gives it that firm and precise hit that we expect from a high-level racket. When we hit hard, it responds very well and conveys a lot of confidence, something we especially like in volleys, layups and shots.

Inside it incorporates SC Black EVA with a density of 15, a rubber that goes very well with the 12K carbon. The result is a balanced touch, with good ball output when we play at a slower speed and a more forceful response when we press the shot.

The Hybrid Spin finish helps work spin on vipers, layups and slice shots.

It also incorporates a longer handle, a particularly interesting detail for players who use the two-handed backhand.

Su amplio punto dulce, núcleo HR3 Black EVA y rugosidad Impact Marks ofrecen una combinación de control, agilidad y firmeza para disfrutar de un juego dinámico. INTRODUCCIÓN DE LA PALA

La ENEBE MX TURBO RED 2027 tiene algo que se agradece mucho en pádel: te permite centrarte en el punto sin estar pendiente de si vas a llegar bien colocado a cada bola.

Es una pala de formato lágrima con la que se consigue tanto potencia como control.

TIPO DE JUGADOR

Nos parece especialmente acertada para jugadores de nivel medio-alto y avanzado que tienen un juego activo y les gusta anticiparse al rival.

CARACTERÍSTICAS DE LA PALA

Esta versión Red mantiene ese carácter ágil de la familia MX Turbo, con una estética deportiva que le da un toque de personalidad. Una Enebe para quienes disfrutan jugando con velocidad, pero sin perder la cabeza intentando terminar todos los puntos a la primera.

La ENEBE MX TURBO RED 2027 apuesta por una estructura aerodinámica y un punto dulce muy amplio, dos detalles que ayudan a ganar rapidez de reacción y ofrecen mayor margen cuando golpeamos fuera del centro.

Fabricada con fibra de carbono 12K, un carbono firme y de lo más potente. El marco de carbono refuerza el conjunto y aporta estabilidad frente a los impactos, mientras que la tecnología Impact Marks incorpora una rugosidad tridimensional que favorece el agarre de la pelota en distintas direcciones.

The ENEBE MX TURBO RED 2027 has something that is very appreciated in padel: it allows you to focus on the point without worrying about whether you are going to reach each ball well placed.

It is a teardrop format racket with which you achieve both power and control.

PLAYER TYPE

We find it especially suitable for medium-high and advanced level players who have an active game and like to anticipate their rival.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

This Red version maintains that agile character of the MX Turbo family, with a sporty aesthetic that gives it a touch of personality. An Enebe for those who enjoy playing with speed, but without losing their minds trying to finish all the points the first time.

The ENEBE MX TURBO RED 2027 is committed to an aerodynamic structure and a very large sweet spot, two details that help to gain reaction speed and offer greater margin when we hit off-center.

Made with 12K carbon fiber, a firm and most powerful carbon. Its HR3 Black EVA core combines quick recovery with a firm feel, allowing you to control the ball output without losing response when accelerating. The carbon frame reinforces the whole and provides stability against impacts, while the Impact Marks technology incorporates a three-dimensional roughness that favors the grip of the ball in different directions.

products.title: Drop Shot Axion Attack 2024 Jon Sanz - Palas De Padel
products.description:
DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ - Jon Sanz's new padel racket for 2024 in the Premier Pádel professional padel league. A model that combines great precision, along with fantastic power thanks to its teardrop mold and technologies.

 INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

Drop Shot is one of the leading brands in the padel racket sector. Models like the classic Conqueror have been with us for almost a decade. Today we bring you the DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ, the new racket that the Premier Padel player Jon Sanz will use, and that seeks maximum power without losing the control that characterizes it.

PLAYER TYPE

The DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ has been created for advanced or professional level players looking for a versatile padel racket made of great materials.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

The new DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ contains elements that make it stand out as a perfect padel racket for powerful players. It is a racket created in a teardrop format, with a good sweet spot and handling, which facilitates maximum power in the game without loss of control.

In its manufacturing, Drop Shot has used common elements in its padel rackets such as plain carbon and Hotmelt technology to make its frame more resistant and durable, a double tubular of carbon fabrics with maximum durability, which gives it greater rigidity and allows it to not lose power. Textrem Cubicarbon 18K twill technology appears on the interlocking carbon faces, giving the faces flexibility and greater durability for a more comfortable and pleasant touch.

Along with these materials, top-of-the-range technologies appear such as the 3D FACE, in a rhomboidal shape that provides greater spin to the ball when hitting, ideal for aggressive players and sliced ​​shots. The Anti Twist System technology also appears in this model, preventing vibrations, making this DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ one of the ideal padel rackets for players who want a powerful racket but with good balance.  In the core we find EVA PRO rubber with greater hardness and elasticity, which provides better control and touch of the ball.

It incorporates a protector on the frame of the racket to increase its durability, what the Madrid firm calls Ergo Pro Protector.

BLADE DESIGN

The design of the DROP SHOT AXION ATTACK 2024 JON SANZ has opted for a striking color combination, which changes yellow, silver, black and green.

PLAY STYLE

The new DROP SHOT EXPLORER PRO 3.0 is one of the ideal Drop Shot rackets for advanced or professional players who want an attacking racket, but with good control.

products.description:
NOX VENTUS HYBRID 12K XTREM BY EDU ALONSO 2027 - La NOX Ventus Hybrid 12K XTREM 2027, desarrollada junto a Edu Alonso, es una pala polivalente para jugadores avanzados que buscan precisión desde cualquier parte de la pista.
*PRECOMPRA: SERÁ ENVIADA A PARTIR DEL DÍA 2 DE NOVIEMBRE*
 INTRODUCCIÓN DE LA PALA

La nueva NOX VENTUS HYBRID 12K XTREM BY EDU ALONSO 2027 lleva el sello de Edu Alonso, un jugador que sabe cuándo acelerar el punto y cuándo trabajar la bola hasta encontrar el hueco. Esta nueva Ventus sigue esa misma filosofía: ofrecer recursos para defender con confianza y pasar al ataque sin necesidad de cambiar la forma de jugar. 

El nuevo color para esta temporada es sencillamente espectacular, nos encanta ese tono azul metalizado.

TIPO DE JUGADOR

Perfecta para todo tipo de jugadores sobre todo si buscas un juego polivalente de más control pero con la potencia necesaria para apretar cuando se requiera.

CARACTERÍSTICAS DE LA PALA

Empezamos por su formato lágrima, como la edición pasada. Un molde que ofrece muy buenos resultados junto a un balance equilibrado.

En las caras encontramos Carbon Fiber 12K XTREM, cuya trama especial aumenta la rigidez y reparte la energía de manera uniforme para conseguir una respuesta sólida y precisa.

La goma MLD Black EVA aporta salida de bola cuando toca defender y permite imprimir potencia al rematar. Si te gusta jugar con efectos, el acabado Dual Spin combina relieve 3D y arena de silicio para trabajar mejor las bandejas, víboras y golpes cortados.

Además, incorpora el nuevo sistema VCS, que filtra un 60 % de los picos de vibración que llegan al brazo respecto a su predecesora, y Weight Balance, con el que puedes añadir contrapesos de 2 y 4 gramos, hasta un máximo de 8 gramos, para modificar el peso y el balance a tu gusto.

 INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The new color for this season is simply spectacular, we love that metallic blue tone.

products.title: Hbl Bid - Hbl
products.description:
HBL BUD - If you are starting out in this sport, it is a very comfortable and reliable padel racket to take those first steps. INTRODUCTION OF THE SHOVEL

The HBL BUD is a Spanish brand racket. Made for beginner players and with quality materials for correct and easy use from the first contact. It has an attractive white design.

PLAYER TYPE

It is a padel racket designed for beginner players, who are taking their first steps in padel and are looking for security, comfort and ease of play from day one.

CHARACTERISTICS OF THE PADDLE

This HBL BUD padel racket has a teardrop shape, a more than correct format to achieve control and a little more power than with a round racket.

As for its construction, it has been designed in a single piece of fiberglass, which provides a very pleasant feeling of flexibility when hitting. As it is a flexible material, the racket responds more easily, considerably increasing the ball output.

Its interior is made of soft EVA rubber, which absorbs impact well and reduces vibrations, making hitting more comfortable and controlled.
